date_entry_surface_label: Example State official voter-information date-entry fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that require a date before revealing the current answer keep date purpose, visible format cues, typed-date fallback, and correction-friendly widget behavior clear enough that the answer does not depend on a brittle calendar control.
date_field_purpose_note: Critical date fields state which date is required, such as date of birth, appointment date, or election date, before the voter interacts with a widget.
visible_date_format_note: Date format expectations are visible in text when needed and do not depend on placeholder-only hints or iconography.
typed_date_fallback_note: If a date picker is present, the voter can still type the date manually and keep the keyboard active whenever reasonably possible.
calendar_widget_optionality_note: Calendar popovers or browser-native pickers act as helpers rather than as the only workable path to the answer lane.
segmented_date_entry_note: Split month/day/year fields remain plainly labeled and correction-friendly without auto-advancing focus.
date_bounds_and_window_note: Meaningful min/max bounds or allowed date windows are visible before failure rather than appearing only after submission.
locale_and_normalization_note: Displayed date cues and accepted date semantics stay aligned across locale-sensitive controls, native pickers, and typed entry.
no_hidden_context_change_note: Focusing or partially entering a date does not silently reroute the page, auto-submit the form, or discard the previously typed value.
same_answer_across_date_entry_variants_n: Typed, native-picker, custom-picker, and segmented-date paths resolve to the same authoritative answer and fallback lane for the same date.
